quest.title: Rocking Carriage
quest.description: Masud, known as the Phantom Toy Master, is at the Sabzeruz Festival recommending his new game to guests...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Masud
dialogues.text: Why, my greetings to you, dear traveler from afar, and to your little friend. Have you been enjoying the Sabzeruz Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Masud
dialogues.text: If you're both interested, I, the Phantom Toy Master, shall be pleased to invite you to play a new game — the "Rocking Carriage," a flower that blooms only during the Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just hearing the name, Paimon's kinda imagining Nahida happily swaying from side to side in her carriage!

choices.text: Even I'm getting all gladsome over here!

response.speaker: Masud
response.text: Wonderful! All in Sumeru wish that the "Dendro Archon shall be happy every day," after all.

response.speaker: Masud
response.text: That association you made... Ah, what an excellent scene! One that deserves to be rendered upon a magnificent scroll, if I do say so myself!

response.speaker: Masud
response.text: Still, the atmosphere of this game is a livelier thing. Rather than a celebration, it's best thought of as an adventure—

response.speaker: Masud
response.text: "Smart or not, nice or naughty, every child with a good heart will receive their own Flower Carriage during the Sabzeruz Festival celebrations..."

response.speaker: Masud
response.text: "Riding in their carriage, the children shall embark on unique adventures, encountering and overcoming danger, and finding the greatest treasure, a thousand blooming flowers..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, that's right! And as for that treasure, it may as well be ours already!

response.speaker: Masud
response.text: Haha, good, good. In that case, play on, play to your hearts' content!

choices.text: Just hearing you say that makes me wanna watch Nahida do that too...
